reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD has its own workbench tool bars and enables tools from its BarCtx state; there is no Matrix Top 11 catalogue.
Selection is QymCAD document-model state, not an OM9 ObjectId set with document stamps.
The curve edits are sketch-entity operations tied to QymCAD's Project/Id model.

rationale: QymCAD's bars enable tools by its own workbench/selection state. The Top 11 availability table, reasons and icon keys are OM9 host policy.
not_reused: QymCAD BarCtx/Hand UI state and its sketch Id document model.
QymCAD native/OCCT adapters; the Top 11 are host command adapters over OM9's document.
l3_scope: One availability rule for all eleven buttons: selection/kind/running checks, a disabled reason, tooltip text and icon identity. Split/Trim enter a cutting-curve prompt and Duplicate enters a base-point prompt; all buttons disable while any prompt runs. Ring Rail stays disabled until the M04 builder exists. F10 is the only documented keyboard shortcut.
